NOMOR 04 TAHUN 2017
TENTANG
PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
KORBAN KEKERASAN
I. UMUM
Berbagai tindakan kekerasan baik terhadap perempuan maupun anak di dalam  rumah tangga maupun di luar rumah tangga terus meningkat dari waktu ke waktu.  Kondisi ini apabila tanpa suatu penanganan yang serius, akan menghancurkan  kehidupan rumah tangga, masyarakat, bangsa dan negara. Oleh karena itu,  pemerintah Kabupaten Maluku Tenggara Barat berkewajiban memberikan  perlindungan kepada perempuan dan anak korban tindak kekerasan yang  merupakan implementasi dari berbagai peraturan perundang-undangan,  diantaranya Undang-undang Nomor 39 Tahun 1999 tentang Hak Asasi Manusia,  Undang-undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2004 tentang Penghapusan Kekerasan Dalam  Rumah Tangga, Undang-undang Nomor 21 Tahun 2007 tentang Pemberantasan  Tindak Perdagangan Orang, Undang-undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2002 tentang  Perlindungan Anak.
Perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan adalah  kewajiban Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimana diatur dalam pasal 22 huruf a,  Undang-undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2004 tentng Pemerintahan Daerah yang  menyatakan "bahwa dalam menjalankan otonomi daerah mempunyai kewajiban,  melindungi masyarakat, menjaga persatuan, kesatuan dan kerukunan nasional  serta keutuhan Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia".
Atas dasar itu, pemerintah Kabupaten Maluku Tenggara Barat telah melakukan  langkah-langkah sebagai upaya untuk memberikan perlindungan kepada  perempuan dan anak korban tindak kekerasan, namun belum mampu memberikan  perlindungan yang maksimal dan memadai terhadap tindak kekerasan yang terjadi  dalam kehidupan sosial masyarakat khususnya kepada perempuan dan anak,  antara lain disebabkan masih rendahnya pemahaman masyarakat terhadap hak hak perempuan dan anak, penanganan belum terkoordinasi dengan baik,  pelaksanaannya belum berkesinambungan dan sebagainya. Oleh karena itu,  diperlukan suatu regulasi berupa Peraturan Daerah tentang Penyelenggaraan  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Karban Kekerasan untuk menjawab sekaligus memberikan kepastian hukum dalam perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban  dari tindak kekerasan yang terj adi.
Adanya Peraturan Daerah tentang Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan  Anak Korban Kekerasan, memberikan tanggung jawab kepada Pemerintah Daerah  mulai dari pencegahan terjadi tindak kekerasan hingga penanganan korban tindak  kekerasan.Dalam implementasinya Pemerintah Daerah bekerjasama dengan  instansi pemerintah dan masyarakat. Selain itu dukungan pendanaan yang  memadai dari Pemerintah Daerah maupun peran serta masyarakat, diharapkan  kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak dapat berkurang bahkan pada waktunya  ..
akan terhapus dari muka bumi Maluku Tenggara Barat tercinta ini.
translated_text:
EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF MALUKU PROVINCE
NUMBER 04 YEAR 2017
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Various acts of violence both against women and children within the household as well as outside the household continue to increase from time to time. This condition, if without serious handling, will destroy household life, society, nation and state. Therefore, the government of West Southeast Maluku Regency is obligated to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection.
Protection of women and children from acts of violence is the obligation of Regional Government as regulated in article 22 letter a, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence which states "that in carrying out regional autonomy has the obligation to protect the community, maintain unity, oneness and national harmony as well as the integrity of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia".
On that basis, the government of West Southeast Maluku Regency has taken steps as efforts to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence, however it has not been able to provide maximum and adequate protection against acts of violence that occur in the social life of the community especially to women and children, among others caused by the still low understanding of the community regarding the rights of women and children, handling has not been well coordinated, implementation has not been sustainable and so forth. Therefore, a regulation in the form of Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence is needed to answer while providing legal certainty in the protection of women and children victims from acts of violence that occur.
The existence of Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence, gives responsibility to the Regional Government starting from prevention of acts of violence to handling of victims of acts of violence. In its implementation the Regional Government cooperates with government agencies and the community. In addition, adequate funding support from the Regional Government as well as community participation, it is hoped that violence against women and children can be reduced and even in time will be eliminated from the face of this beloved West Southeast Maluku.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: incorrect legal reference—original cites Article 22 letter a of Law No. 23/2004 on Domestic Violence, but translation renders it as Law No. 23/2004 on Regional Government.

translated_text:
Article 2
Letter a What is meant by "the principle of respect for human rights" is that the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is to guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of victims of violence as a manifestation of respect for human rights.
Letter b What is meant by "the principle of non-discrimination" is all actions and deeds carried out without distinguishing based on economic, social, cultural, political background, gender, age, religion, race and so forth.
Letter c What is meant by "the principle of justice and gender equality" is a process of equality and conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so as to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, social, cultural activities, national defense and security and equality in enjoying the results of such development.
Letter c What is meant by "the principle of victim protection" is the protection of self, family, honor, dignity and property under one's control, a sense of security and protection from threats of fear, freedom from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity.
Letter d What is meant by "the principle of non-discrimination" is the attitude and treatment toward victims without making distinctions based on age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.
Letter e What is meant by "the principle of the best interests of the Victim" is all actions concerning victims carried out by the government, society, legislative bodies and judicial bodies, where the best interests of the victim must be the primary consideration.
